subject: X-axis title colliding with x-axis tick labels

messages.author: d994cff5897faec8
messages.subject: X-axis title colliding with x-axis tick labels
parts:
The attached R script reproduces the attached PDF graphic. It's been
very heavily tweaked for publication, and I have just one problem
left: the x-axis title collides with the x-axis tick labels. I can't
find any way to move the x-axis title down a couple of points so it
doesn't collide. Help?

(Advice on how to do any/all of the tweakage more elegantly would also
be appreciated. I'm especially unfond of what I had to do to get a
legend in the upper right hand corner, without huge horizontal gaps on
either side of it. As you may guess from the overall size of the PDF,
space is at a premium in this paper.)

zw

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: X-axis title colliding with x-axis tick labels
parts:
This has been an issue since 0.89 was released. You need to use opts() axis.x.text


opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(hjust = -3, vjust = 7))

I can't remember if it's hjust or vjust, but try different combinations of them until it looks right. 

I hope this is fixed in 0.90. I think Takahashi-san said it would be. 

Brandon

messages.subject: Re: X-axis title colliding with x-axis tick labels
parts:
I came across this recently too. In the current release version of ggplot2, there's a bug in theme_bw(). You need to add something like this:
  opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(vjust = 0.5) )

You may also need to adjust the font size for your particular graph.

See here for more info:
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/9437d49e3c4f183b/f5a3aec61ec1b61c?lnk=gst&q=theme_bw#f5a3aec61ec1b61c

-Winston
